description: This file defines the 'UriResolver' class in the 'GuzzleHttp\Psr7' namespace, which provides static methods for resolving and relativizing URIs according to RFC 3986. It includes methods for removing dot segments from paths, resolving relative URIs against a base URI, and obtaining relative references between URIs.

classes.name: UriResolver
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for URI resolution and relativization following RFC 3986.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments ('..' and '.') from a URI path, normalizing it.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI to produce an absolute URI.

methods.name: relativize
methods.description: Generates a relative URI from a base URI to a target URI.
